en: Hello, pickup {del_id} on {date}: {litres} litres, fat {fat}, protein {protein}, cell count {scc}. The result is: {result}. Please confirm that this matches your test.

en: Hello, please visit the farm to treat {name} ({kind}) for pests before we fill it again. The last clean-down was on {last_clean}. Tell us your first free day.
mt: Halo, silakan kunjungi peternakan untuk mengobati hama sebelum kami mengisi lagi.

en: The cost of one unit is {col:unitcost.cost_unit} and the price is {col:unitcost.price_unit}, so the margin is {col:unitcost.margin_unit} for each unit ({col:unitcost.margin_pct} of the price). The margin check shows: {col:unitcost.state}.
mt: Biaya satu unit adalah {col:unitcost.cost_unit} dan harga adalah {col:unitcost.price_unit}, jadi margin adalah {col:unitcost.margin_unit} untuk setiap unit ({col:unitcost.margin_pct} dari harga).

en: Our targets are a lay rate of {set:lay_target} and cracked eggs below {set:crack_limit}. The check shows: {col:eggs.state}.
mt: Target kita adalah tingkat bertelur {set:lay_target} dan telur retak di bawah {set:crack_limit}.

en: The moisture is {col:bins.moisture} and the moisture check shows: {col:bins.moist_state}. The last inspection was on {col:bins.last_inspect} and the check shows: {col:bins.insp_state}. The value of the content is {col:bins.value}.
mt: Kelembaban adalah {col:bins.moisture} dan pemeriksaan kelembaban menunjukkan: {col:bins.moist_state}. Pemeriksaan terakhir adalah pada {col:bins.last_inspect} dan pemeriksaan menunjukkan: {col:bins.insp_state}.

en: The affected stock was separated, the area was cleaned and the cause was written in the store record. Our accepted storage loss is {set:loss_limit} of the stock.
mt: Stok yang terkena dipisahkan, daerah itu dibersihkan dan penyebabnya ditulis dalam catatan toko.

en: Product: {col:pack.product}, quality {col:pack.pclass}. We packed {col:pack.crates} crates of {col:pack.crate_kg} kilograms, which is {col:pack.net_kg} kilograms net or {col:pack.tonnes} tonnes.
mt: Kami mengemas kotak-kotak {col:pack.crates} dengan {col:pack.crate_kg} kilogram, yang merupakan {col:pack.net_kg} kilogram bersih atau {col:pack.tonnes} ton.

en: We took out {col:pack.rejected_kg} kilograms as rejects ({col:pack.reject_pct}). The value of the load is {col:pack.value}. The packing check shows: {col:pack.state}.
mt: Kami mengambil {col:pack.rejected_kg} kilogram sebagai penolakan ({col:pack.reject_pct}). Nilai muatan adalah {col:pack.value}.

en: Hello {contractor}, please send the work record for {machine} on {field}: hours, hectares and any waiting time. We compare it with our log of about {hours} hours.

en: Hello {name}, the shift starts at 6:00 tomorrow. Please come in your protective clothing and check the work list with your supervisor first.
mt: Halo, giliranmu dimulai pukul 6:00 besok. silakan datang dengan pakaian pelindungmu dan periksa daftar pekerjaan dengan supervisormu dulu.

en: Hello {name}, welcome to the farm. Your work starts on {start_date}. Please come to the main gate at 6:00 and ask for {leader}. Bring your identity document and work boots.
mt: Halo, selamat datang di peternakan. pekerjaan Anda dimulai pada pukul 01:00. silakan datang ke gerbang utama pada pukul 06:00 dan meminta untuk 02:00. membawa dokumen identitas Anda dan sepatu bot kerja.

en: Hello {manager}, in {month} we need {seasonal_needed} seasonal workers and have {seasonal_hired} on contract, so {gap} workers are short. Please start hiring now.
mt: Halo, kami membutuhkan pekerja musiman dan memiliki kontrak, jadi kami kekurangan pekerja.

en: Hello {manager}, the labour cost for {month} is {labour_cost} against a budget of {budget}. Budget left: {variance}. Please check the overtime and the piece-rate pay.
